description: Review code or a design for failure-mode gaps — missing timeouts, unsafe retries, absent degradation paths — one line per finding.
Audit error handling — empty or over-broad catches, swallowed exceptions, message-string branching, missing cause chains, internals leaking to users — one line per finding.
Audit code for concurrency hazards — check-then-act races, missing idempotency on retried paths, unguarded parallel writes, locks without TTL or fencing — one line per finding.
